verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that the Secretary of State's own site offers downloadable business forms and instructions without an account; the probes record a 403 at ohiosos.gov and the filing portal's robots.txt, and nothing on those hosts was fetched. The only forms evidence is the Department of Taxation's tax forms library, which belongs to a different agency, covers tax documents rather than filing forms, and does not say whether an account is needed. The Gateway material centers on OHID sign-in, so it does not establish account-free access either.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
